penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: PDPL compliance advisory inherently requires per-client human judgment — architecture review, data mapping, legal interpretation — that cannot be automated by Claude alone.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise compliance engagements universally require scoping calls, stakeholder meetings, and iterative sign-off — not a self-serve async flow.

penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: PDPL is a data-protection regulation with legal liability; providing compliance guidance constitutes quasi-legal advisory work with licensure and jurisdiction risk.

rationale: The pain is severe and the budgets are real — enterprises pay consultants six figures for this work — but that is precisely the problem: this is a bespoke, high-judgment legal-compliance engagement that requires human consultants, not a product a solo non-technical operator can build and run autonomously. Operational autonomy is 3 because every client needs custom architecture review and legal interpretation; buildability is 4 because a Claude prompt cannot substitute for a licensed compliance advisor on PDPL. Three stacked penalties (human fulfillment, synchronous human, regulated industry) drop the score to 1.3.
solution_plan: This opportunity is not viable for a solo non-technical operator running an autonomous Claude factory. The work is fundamentally consultative (each client has a unique Salesforce org topology, data flows, and legal exposure) and legally regulated (giving PDPL compliance advice without appropriate legal backing creates liability). A Claude-generated guide or checklist could exist as a lead magnet, but the actual service would require Youval or a hired consultant to do per-client work — which is the opposite of what this factory is optimized for. Dropping this candidate is the right call.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy_min (3 < 7) and buildability_with_ai_min (4 < 6). Would be a strong opportunity for a boutique compliance consultancy, not an autonomous AI factory.
